systems.platform: KOBO digital data collection at localised levels; otherwise predominantly paper-based processes; no integrated web-based platform
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, across federal, state and locality levels; no costed national EMIS policy (2021 EMIS analysis)
systems.tiers: Federal, state and locality; data collected through parallel survey instruments that the 2021 analysis recommends merging into one harmonised survey; insufficient digital devices at school level

systems.owner: State Ministries of Education, supported by UNICEF and Save the Children (GPE System Transformation Grant); UNESCO's System Capacity Grant takes policy and standards
systems.tiers: Planned for Khartoum and Al Jazirah State Ministries of Education, to restore core planning and monitoring functions; no national rollout under current conditions

systems.country_label: Rapid School Survey; Rapid School Census Survey
systems.platform: printed forms with mobile and digital technologies
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, with SPEEP in year one (from 2025) and BRIDGES (UNICEF) for two further rounds
systems.tiers: A simplified school census of school functionality, enrolment by grade, teachers and infrastructure; to be conducted in all 18 states; modelled on the World Bank Basic Education Recovery Project's annual census run over four academic years

note: No system holding a record per learner is described: the EMIS is survey returns and the Rapid Survey is a simplified school census, so both are census and give no fact. The 2021 analysis's 'predominantly paper-based management processes' describes EMIS administration, not learner records at schools. The planned two-state pilot is described only as restoring ministry planning and monitoring, so it is unclassified. Targets on record: 40 education officers, down to headmasters, to be trained in EMIS.
